description: This file defines a VersionAPI class within the OrangeHRM installer API namespace, extending an existing upstream VersionAPI class. It customizes the handleGet method to modify request query parameters before invoking the parent method.
published:
OrangeHRM	emp uilt-in

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: A controller API class for version handling in the installer, extending a base VersionAPI class and customizing the GET request handling.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Overrides the handleGet method to modify the request by setting the 'excludeLatest' query parameter based on the boolean value obtained from the request, then calls the parent implementation.
